name: internal_reward
description: The epoch rewards a bank credited or debited while it was prepared: the VAT debits and vote commission rewards of the first block of an epoch and the stake rewards of the partition blocks that follow, in the order they were applied

bank_seq.description: Bank sequence number of the bank that credited the rewards

is_leader.description: True if the bank is a block this validator is producing

rewards.description: Rewards applied, each one agave reward entry of the block

reward_type.description: agave RewardType: 3 staking, 4 voting, 5 deactivated stake, 6 VAT debit

commission_bps.description: Commission of the vote account in basis points, UINT_MAX when agave records none

lamports.description: Lamports credited, negative for a debit

post_balance.description: Lamports of the account after the reward
